title: Neglected Tropical Disease Geographic Distribution
description: Stylized world map of neglected tropical disease (NTD) endemic regions with per-region DALY burden, top NTDs, and preventive-chemotherapy program status. Includes filters for individual NTDs and a per-capita metric toggle.
creator: Introduction to Public Health Project
subject: public health
global health
neglected tropical diseases
DALYs
preventive chemotherapy
WHO
IHME GBD
learningObjective: Students can identify the geographic regions where neglected tropical diseases concentrate and describe how specific NTDs (soil-transmitted helminths, schistosomiasis, lymphatic filariasis, trachoma, onchocerciasis) cluster in different parts of the tropical world.

controls.label: NTD
controls.purpose: Filters the map to show the geographic distribution of a single NTD; the color ramp rescales to the selected disease.

controls.label: Metric
controls.purpose: Toggles between absolute disease burden and per-capita burden, revealing where NTD impact is most intense relative to population size.

controls.label: Reset
controls.purpose: Clears the selected region and returns both dropdowns to default.

modelType: conceptual geographic concept map (illustrative, not data-driven)
assumptions: Region polygons are stylized representations of major NTD endemic zones, not accurate national borders.
DALY values and per-100k rates are plausible illustrative figures based on the IHME Global Burden of Disease 2021 study; they are not live data pulls.
Per-NTD transmission intensity multipliers reflect published WHO endemicity patterns for each disease.
limitations: Not a substitute for official WHO or IHME GBD geographic data.
Sub-national heterogeneity within each region is not represented.
Stylized world outline does not represent accurate national borders or coastlines.
Only nine endemic regions are modeled; many countries with NTD burden are aggregated or omitted.
